differential_oracle.implementation: JSON-value-based reference interpreter compared against the production typed-state interpreter
differential_oracle.coverage: Typed trace checker + JSON-value differential interpreter over all 12 frozen traces and 13 adversarial mutations plus event-metadata-scoping rejection in the executable matrix runner; independent test-only finite lifecycle/connectivity graph (252 states, 7,812 state/action transitions); 18 orthogonal policy truth-table combinations, whose event classes also interleave with lifecycle actions. Event-level connectivity degradation, recovery, and metadata scoping are executed by the mutation matrix.
differential_oracle.limits: Same repository and shared invariants/fixtures; implementation-diversity and finite abstraction checks only, not external clinical adjudication, formally verified specification, stateful connectivity/freshness/consent interactions, or clinical validation.
differential_oracle.state_model_scope: Finite 252-state lifecycle/connectivity graph; 31 action types combine lifecycle/connectivity with six resource freshness/presentation events, four sensitive-payload/consent events, and unknown normalization. Event-local policy actions are interleaved in state-action edges and bounded suffix sequences; the underlying freshness, consent and normalization facts do not persist as lifecycle state. Separate exhaustive truth tables continue to cover all 18 local combinations. Same-repository finite abstraction only; no external clinical ground truth.
differential_oracle.policy_truth_table_scope: 18 explicit combinations over connectivity/requirement (6), freshness/presentation (6), sensitivity/consent (4), and unknown normalization (2), separately exhaustive truth tables, with matching event actions integrated into the 31-action differential graph.
differential_oracle.edge_differential_scope: For each of 252 reachable abstract states, replay its breadth-first shortest event-history witness, append each of the 31 actions, and compare ordered violations from the production JSON trace checker with the abstract transition model; expected 252 states and 7,812 edges. Same repo, shared design intent, and finite abstraction; not independent clinical ground truth.
differential_oracle.policy_truth_table_differential_scope: 18 connectivity, freshness/presentation, sensitivity/consent, and unknown-normalization combinations are each compared against the production trace checker; no claim that these truth tables model temporal coupling between those domains.
differential_oracle.two_action_sequence_differential_scope: For each of 252 reachable abstract states, take its breadth-first shortest witness, append every ordered pair from the 31-action alphabet, and compare the full ordered violation list from model replay to the production JSON trace checker: 252 × 31 × 31 = 242,172 sequences. This is bounded suffix coverage, not all possible event histories or clinical ground truth.
differential_oracle.seeded_long_horizon_scope: Run 4,096 deterministic action histories of lengths 1 through 64 using the pinned xorshift64* seed; every history is compared against the typed production trace checker and the abstract model. The seed and count are required in receipt v1.1. This is bounded, same-repository differential testing, not formal verification or clinical ground truth.
